integrity: The matrix inverse, positive-definiteness range, conjugate-gradient recurrence, denominator sign, threshold polynomial, explicit witness, and dimension-minimality argument are derived explicitly. A standalone exact-rational checker replays the witness and formula comparisons without external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: The sharp parameter threshold is for the displayed three-dimensional tridiagonal Stieltjes family and the forcing family \(b_B\), not for all Stieltjes matrices. The theorem assumes exact arithmetic. Full-text comparison with the 1977 symmetric-M-matrix paper and the 2026 nonnegative-CG preprint was not available through the checked routes, leaving a residual originality risk for specialized overlap.
title: Three dimensions are minimal for positivity loss in conjugate gradients on Stieltjes systems
